scope: Local owner-controlled finite typed semantic runtime with operator-installed task+solver approval. No live user Mac deployment performed.

trust_boundary.implementation: V4 checks directory/file ownership and permissions, no-follow directory-relative open, regular single-link policy, bounded read, default-deny policy; exact SHA256 match of approved task+solver; V2 rederived IR and solver contract validation before execution
trust_boundary.operational_assumption: Same-UID malicious program, compromised owner installation or administrator intentionally bypassing the policy are outside this interface's threat model.

verification.positive_approval_test_source: real non-mocked policy file installed atomically into isolated owner-owned runtime bundle

accepted_claim: Versioned V4 authorized entrypoint rejects unapproved task/solver and forged IR for the pinned finite typed runtime; owner-installed policy positive integration and negative controls are verified on Render Linux.
not_claimed: V1/V2 legacy execution entrypoints are retroactively secure
recommended_next_step: User-owned Mac installation is a separate opt-in environment acceptance step, not required to close this code-level trust-boundary issue.
